Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that the founding year of Virginia Commonwealth University (VCU) is 1968, despite the provided search results explicitly stating "Virginia Commonwealth University... was founded in 1838" in multiple authoritative sources (Wikipedia, VCU Bulletins, US News, and the official VCU website). The Planner failed to recognize that the 1838 date is the accepted founding year for VCU (tracing back to the Medical Department of Hampden-Sydney College), whereas 1968 is the year the current name was adopted via merger. By prioritizing the 1968 date as the "founding" year and dismissing the 1838 date as merely a "predecessor" origin, the Planner provided an answer (1968) that contradicts the ground truth (1838) and the explicit text of the retrieved sources.
